title: Resistance force correct
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) is correctly given as f = P/v.

title: Acceleration at v/4 correct
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) is correctly given as a = 3P/(mv).

title: Acceleration time correct
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) is correctly given as t = mv²/(2P).

title: Power-force-speed relation
description: Important: Correctly applies the formula P = Fv to find traction force at different speeds.

title: Net force from Newton's law
description: Important: Uses Newton's second law (F_net = ma) by finding the difference between traction and resistance forces.

title: Maximum speed condition
description: Important: Identifies that at maximum speed v, net force is zero so traction force equals resistance force.

title: Kinematics for constant acceleration
description: Optional: Correctly applies kinematic equations (v = a t) for the uniformly accelerated segment in part (3).

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly adds traction and resistance forces instead of subtracting to find net force.

title: Power formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Uses P = Fv with an incorrect force (e.g., net force) or incorrect speed for the given condition.
